title: Acumalaka
blurb: Pure phonetic joy with no meaning attached to it whatsoever. The chant moved through TikTok like a spell nobody could stop casting: fun to hear, considerably more fun to say, and completely impossible to explain to an adult who asks what it means. It belongs to the brainrot canon, where sounds are valued for how they feel in the mouth rather than for any content. Play it as a greeting, a victory cry, or an incantation over something you would very much like to go well. Acumalaka.
origin: A viral brainrot chant from TikTok.
